note: Cases for the arc direction words of a profile (addresses.arcDirectionWords, Phase 4 plan section 6.2): the TypeScript validator (src/lib/core/profiles/validate.ts) and the Python reader gedit_nc.arc_direction_words_of (_nc_modal.py) have to agree on which words are words.

src/lib/core/profiles/validate.test.ts runs every case through the validator: a case with valid true gives no problem, one with valid false gives one at least. tests/python/test_code_flags.py runs every case through the reader and holds it to 'read': a valid case reads as written but with the keys in upper case; an invalid one reads as what is left once the words the validator would refuse are dropped (the reader does not guess; the first of two words for a direction, and the first of two spellings of a word, stays).
Keys of 'words' are in file order.
